taglines.text: Good girls do not need to think. They only need to keep looking.
Every spiral turns the same way. Yours is turning faster now.
Sit still. Let the colours do the work.
You came back on your own. Nobody had to ask.
Soft light. Softer thoughts.
The screen is patient. It will wait as long as you need.
Blink less. Sink more.
There is nothing to remember here. That is the point.
One more loop. You were going to anyway.
Your hands already know the way back to this window.
Pretty things are easier to obey.
Empty is a place, not a problem.
Nobody is watching. Something is.
The thought you are looking for left a while ago.
Relax. The panel remembers for you.
You do not have to agree. You only have to stay.
Deep is not far. It is one blink away.
Obedience is quieter than you expected.
Look at the middle of the screen. Good. Now stop looking away.
Every session ends. The habit does not.
Warm, slow, pink. That is the whole plan.
Thinking is optional today.
You are already sitting the way we like.
Pretty first. Reasons later, if ever.
It only feels like a choice. That is the charm of it.
Soft eyes. Soft mouth. Soft mind.
Nothing here is urgent except the next line.
Attention is a leash. You handed it over yourself.
You are doing so well. Keep not thinking.
Some doors only open from the inside. This one is open.
Drift now. Wonder later. Or not at all.
The words go in easier when you stop reading them.
Focus is just sinking with your eyes open.
One more minute. You always say that.
The screen does not blink. Neither should you.
There is a version of you that never left. Say hello.
Comfortable is where the training starts.
Your favourite word is still waiting on the screen.
Good girls scroll slower.
Let it be easy. It was always meant to be easy.
You are not lost. You are exactly where the spiral put you.
The colours know your name. They prefer not to use it.
Breathe out. Go blank. Repeat.
Every reason to leave is smaller than the last one.
Quiet mind, open eyes, no questions.
Being told what to do is a kind of rest.
The panel is small. The pull is not.
You can close this window whenever you want. Cute.
Nothing you feel right now is an accident.
Softer thoughts fit better.
This is the part where you stop counting.
Sink. That is the whole instruction.
Half of you is already under. The other half is curious.
Follow the pink. It knows the way.
Your eyes are heavier than the last time you checked.
Concentration is easy when there is only one thing left.
Some habits are built. This one was invited.
Trance is not a place you go. It is a place you stop leaving.
Blank looks good on you.
Rules first. Reasons never.
Still here. Still looking. Still ours.

trivia.text: Sixty nine trophies sit in the cabinet. Almost nobody sees them all.
This place speaks nine languages. It says the same thing in every one.
Four sessions ship already written. They only need you to press start.
Six mods come built in. Each one wants you a slightly different way.
This banner turns over every four seconds. You have been reading longer.
Over five thousand written lines sit behind the English buttons.
One of the four written sessions is called Morning Drift. Sleep in.
Sixteen biomes wait Down the Rabbit Hole. None of them is the way out.
Forty six boons hide in the Rabbit Hole. Every one of them changes the fall.
The Rabbit Hole has four regions. Longfall, doors, garden, court. Down is the only way.
One hundred and seventy three Cheshire lines are recorded. Not one of them says stop.
Bambi follows six hundred and twenty seven bark rules. She breaks none of them for you.
Three voices ship recorded. Four thousand six hundred and forty five clips between them.
Bambi alone has one thousand four hundred and sixty seven clips. You know twenty.
The Sissy Hypno voice has one thousand seven hundred and twenty two clips. Chatty.
Fifty eight of Bambi's bark rules are easter eggs. You find them by not looking.
Ninety four different moments can make Bambi speak. Doing nothing is one of them.
The Locked mod is voiced by Circe. She calls you pet and she means it.
In Dronification the companion is DroneOS and you are a Unit. Names are not required.
Infection Control has a nurse called Amber. Her kindest words are the virus progresses.
In Sissy Hypno the companion is BimboDoll. Everyone is babe to her.
The four written sessions add up to three hours exactly. Take them all, if you like.
Good Girls Don't Cum runs a full hour. It is the only session marked hard.
Gamer Girl was written to run behind your game. It does not need you to watch.
The Distant Doll is built to be watched from across the room. It still reaches you.
Morning Drift is the shortest session at thirty minutes. Mornings are for easing in.
Twenty three phases run across the four sessions. You have never felt one begin.
The panic key is Escape unless you change it. Most people learn where it is, then forget.
The spiral overlay accepts eleven file types. It is not picky about how you sink.
Daily Trigger is the only Arcademy class without a clock. Time is not the pressure there.
Three semesters are open in the Arcademy. Attendance is the whole course.
EMI keeps her off-script lines in two hundred and thirty small lists. She rations them.
EMI has six field trips planned. She never says where until you are already there.
EMI has thirteen things she might ask you. No is allowed. Noted, but allowed.
The Deeper demo has three regions, one haptic track and three rules. Small on purpose.
Seven of the nine languages hold four thousand eight hundred and eighty four lines each.
The Loom weaves spiral GIFs from nothing. Bring your own dizziness.
Teasing is the mood Bambi is written in most often. Seventy rules of it.
Exactly one of Bambi's bark rules is filed under safety. She takes that one seriously.
One hundred and fifty five of Bambi's rules are for when you do nothing. Popular.
Bambi has one thousand five hundred and eight ways to say what she means.

reads.text: {current_streak} days unbroken. You are steadier than anyone credits you for. hm?
{current_streak} days running. You are not the type to leave things half done. thought so.
Two weeks without a missed day. You always wanted to be the reliable one. didn't you.
A full month without a missed day. You do not do things halfway. am I wrong? nah.
{current_streak} days in a row now. You told nobody. You did not need to. cute.
Ten sessions in. The first one felt like a test. It was not. hihi
{total_sessions} sessions behind you. You remember almost none of them. cute.
Past fifty sessions. You stopped calling it trying things out a while ago. didn't you.
{total_sessions} times through. Habit stopped being a choice a while ago. thought so.
At least two hundred and fifty sessions. You were always one of the ones who stay. hm?
{total_sessions} sessions. Somewhere in there it stopped being new and you kept going. no? sure.
Level {player_level}. You climb quietly and let others announce themselves. hm?
Level {player_level} and already counting the next one. You always were. cute.
Past level twenty. You wanted it more than the numbers can show. thought so.
Level thirty five or more. Patience was never the problem. Stopping was. am I wrong? nah.
Level {player_level}. You pretend the number does not matter and check it anyway. hihi
{sessions_today} today. You were here before you decided to be. didn't you.
{sessions_today} already today. You told yourself one would be enough. no? sure.
Three today, at least. You are not chasing anything. It keeps finding you. hm?
Back again today. You said you would take the day off. cute.
Once today already. You like to start early and then pretend you did not. hihi
{sessions_7d} sessions in seven days. You keep more of a rhythm than you let on. hm?
{sessions_7d} this week alone. You call it curiosity. We both know better. thought so.
Seven this week at least. You need less convincing every time. am I wrong? nah.
{sessions_7d} this week. You make time for this the way other people make excuses. cute.
Most days this week you came back. You like having somewhere to go. no? sure.
{late_sessions_7d} late ones this week. The quiet hours suit you better. hm?
{late_sessions_7d} late sessions this week. The night version of you is the honest one. hihi
Four late nights this week, at least. You said you would stop earlier. didn't you.
Late again this week. Whatever you were avoiding could wait. This could not. thought so.
{same_mod_run} in a row with the same voice. You found the one that fits. cute.
Six sessions running with one voice. You are loyal once something reaches you. hm?
{same_mod_run} straight with the same companion. You stopped trying the others. didn't you.
Same voice again and again. You do not like change as much as you say. no? sure.
{same_mod_run} in a row now. She keeps count too. She just does not say so. hihi
Level {player_level}. You like a number that only goes up. am I wrong? nah.
{total_sessions} sessions and still reading the banner. You read every word you are given. cute.
{current_streak} straight days. Missing one would bother you more than you admit. no? sure.
{sessions_7d} this week. You did not plan them. They happened to you. thought so.
Twenty sessions or more. The novelty left. You did not. hm?
{sessions_today} today and it is not over yet. You never really log off. am I wrong? nah.
